resume.intro: Build a résumé from your profile, check how cleanly it reads, and ask an alumnus to review it. Keep up to five, one for each kind of role.
resume.privacyNote: Only you can see your résumés. A mentor sees one when you ask them to review it, and the placement cell sees the copy you attach to a drive.
resume.newBody: We fill in a first draft from your profile, academic record and finished roadmaps. You can change everything.
resume.name: Name
resume.nameHint: For you only, for example "Core IT" or "Analyst".

templateDetail.compact: Tighter, fits more on a page

resume.full: You have {{n}} résumés, the most you can keep. Delete one to start another.
resume.emptyBody: Start one: we prefill it from your profile so you are not starting from a blank page.
resume.deleteBody: The résumé and its review comments are deleted. Copies already attached to drives stay with those drives.
resume.english: Write the résumé itself in English: applicant tracking systems read English, and the PDF is built for them.
resume.improveAfterSave: Save your changes to get suggestions for a point.
resume.reviewIntro: You were asked to review this résumé. Leave comments by section; only its owner can change it.

f.headline: Headline
f.headlineHint: One line under your name, for example "Final-year CSE student, backend".
f.summaryHint: Two or three lines on what you do and what you are looking for.
f.endHint: YYYY or YYYY-MM. Leave empty if it is ongoing.

ats.title: Check your résumé
ats.intro: How cleanly the PDF reads, and which words from a role it shows. A guide to a readable résumé, not a prediction of any employer’s system.
ats.jdHint: Paste the role’s description. It is used for this check only.
ats.saveFirst: The check reads your last saved version.

check.name: Your name is at the top
check.contact: An email or phone number to reach you
check.images: Text only: no images or tables
check.bullets: Points that start with what you did

ats.disclaimer: Add a word only if it is true of you. Recruiters ask about everything on a résumé.

rewrite.title: Improve this point
rewrite.body: Tighter versions that keep what you wrote. Nothing new is added: no numbers, tools or results you did not write.
rewrite.none: No changes to suggest: this point already reads well.
rewrite.facts: Check each suggestion is still true before you use it.
rewrite.diffNote: Highlighted words are new or changed.

comments.title: Review comments
comments.introOwner: Comments from alumni you asked to review this résumé. You can reply here too.
comments.introReviewer: Comment by section. {{name}} is told when you leave one.

interviews.intro: Practise an interview any time, in English, Telugu or Hindi, by typing or speaking. You get honest feedback on each answer, then book a mock with an alumnus.
interviews.emptyBody: Start with an HR round: about fifteen minutes, five questions.

start.title: Start a practice interview
start.noVoice: Voice answers are not available at your college right now, or in this browser. Typing works the same.
start.englishTechnical: Technical questions are asked in English, as in campus rounds. Answer in whichever language you like.
start.none: That is all for today. Come back tomorrow.
start.privacy: Only you see your answers and feedback, unless you share a report with a mentor. Voice recordings are deleted as soon as they are turned into text.

trackDetail.technical: Your branch, at the level you pick

progress.title: Your progress
progress.intro: Average per dimension in each finished practice, newest last.

interviews.unscored: Feedback on this answer was not available.
interviews.someUnscored_one: Feedback on {{count}} answer was not available, so it is not in the averages.
interviews.someUnscored_other: Feedback on {{count}} answers was not available, so they are not in the averages.
interviews.noVerdict: Practice feedback only: it is not a pass or fail, and says nothing about any company’s decision.

voice.notHeard: We could not make out the recording. Type your answer, or record it again.
voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser, or type your answer.
voice.failed: Recording did not work on this device. Type your answer instead.
voice.note: Recordings are deleted once they are turned into text. Up to three minutes per answer.

human.title: Practise with a person
human.body: Book a mock interview with an alumnus who works in this kind of role.
human.bodyCompany: Book a mock interview with an alumnus, ideally one who works at {{company}} or in a similar role.
human.share: When you send the request you can choose to share this report.

bank.intro: Questions your students practise with, alongside the built-in set. Questions the AI writes for a drive wait here until a faculty member approves them.
bank.addBody: It goes straight into the bank, with you as its reviewer.
bank.question: Question
bank.rubricHint: One or two sentences. The feedback compares answers with this.

none.approved: No questions of your own yet
